messages:
Ani: Quick signal — onboarding 'nara-v1' quant (q5 -> int8) on staging shows BLEU regressions for several CJK and mixed-orientation pairs. Starting a thread.

Song: Can you paste the numbers and a quick repro command?

Ani: Baselines (fp16): zh->en BLEU=28.4, ja->en BLEU=29.1. Int8 run: zh->en BLEU=25.9, ja->en BLEU=26.3. chrF down ~1.8 pts across the board. Full stats in /tmp/nara-int8-bleu.json

Raja: Oof. Did the detokenizer/tokenizer change between runs? Those typically cause boundary shifts.

Ani: Good call — staging int8 pipeline pulls 'detok-v2' and tokenizer merge from upstream. Hosted fp16 run used 'detok-v1'. Quick diff I noticed:
```
- detok: normalize_ndash=false
+ detok: normalize_ndash=true
- tokenizer: jieba-upstream-2026-03-12
+ tokenizer: jieba-upstream-2026-03-18
```

Mel: That could flip punctuation and merge/split heuristics. Any change in token counts per sentence?

Ani: Yes — avg tokens/sent increased by ~0.7 for zh inputs in int8 run. Example input: '北京天安門'
- fp16 tokens: ['北京','天安門']
- int8 tokens: ['北京','天','安','門']

Raja: That explains a lot — model expected different subtokenization distribution. Who pushed the tokenizer bump?

Song: That was me — I picked up the newer jieba patch to improve multiword recognition for colloquial Cantonese. I thought it was innocuous. Rolling a temporary revert to repro.

Ani: Repro command I used:
```
python tools/eval_regression.py \
  --model nara-v1-int8 \
  --pairs zh-en ja-en \
  --metric bleu,chrf \
  --sample 1000 \
  --out /tmp/nara-int8-bleu.json
```
Also tried locale-specific prompts from our regression suite (srt/ocr/shortctx). Results saved in gist: https://redwood.internal/g/abcd1234

Mel: Can you also try running int8 with the old detok/tokenizer and with KV-cache disabled? There was a KV cache micro-optim landed last week on the int8 path.

Ani: Did both:
- int8 + old detok/tokenizer => BLEU recovered ~+1.2 (still about -0.5 vs fp16)
- int8 + kvcache disabled => BLEU +0.6 (compared to int8 baseline), but didn't fully close gap.
Sample diffs attached inline.

Raja: Sounds like a mixed-source regression: tokenizer/detok moves majority; quant/kvcache tweaks add delta. Plan:
1) Bisect tokenizer changes to identify which token merge rule caused splits
2) Run int8 with v1-detok & current quant kernels to isolate quant impact
3) If still failing, bisect recent quant commits (esp. kernel selection changes)
4) Produce a canary PR and a short public/internal note summarizing customer impact

Song: I'll start the tokenizer bisect now. Will revert the jieba bump on staging to get a clean int8 run and report back within the hour.

LintBot: Deploy job #4521 started by Song :rocket:

Mel: Also let's add this as a regression alert in Optimize (linking the failing prompt set) and block the dedicated rollout until we have a mitigation or a clear rollback plan.

Ani: I'll upload the minimal failing sample + diffs and open an eval ticket with tagging: regression/cjk-tokenization/regression-3378901234. Thanks folks :pray:

Song: Thanks — ping me if you want pair-debugging; I'll be on call this afternoon.
